premiumPrinciples.layeredKeyframes: Animate 2–4 properties together (opacity, transform, blur, glow).
premiumPrinciples.spring: Prefer spring or overshoot cubic-bezier; settle past target then rest.
premiumPrinciples.secondary: Shadows, glints, echoes follow primary with delay.
premiumPrinciples.motionBlur: Enable ~180° shutter on fast moves; disable when settled.
premiumPrinciples.density: One premium recipe per beat; readable twice on-screen.

animations.name: Soft spring caption (multi-prop)
animations.look: Caption rises with opacity+scale+Y+blur settle — no hard pop.
animations.whyPremium: Layered multi-property keyframes + spring settle + blur-as-MB; optional anticipation.
animations.dont: Don't use linear opacity-only fades for premium talking-head.

animations.name: Karaoke glow track
animations.look: Active word: fill + outer glow + micro-scale; rest dim.
animations.whyPremium: Secondary glow layer + micro overshoot + plate separation.
animations.exampleLine: Watch the catchlights in her eyes
animations.dont: Don't max glow until glyphs bloom.

animations.name: Split-mask dual fill
animations.look: Stacked captions; split mask reveals accent fill as spoken.
animations.whyPremium: Track-matte/split mask + per-word timing.
animations.dont: Don't wipe whole line evenly.

animations.name: Outline offset echo
animations.look: Hollow outline leads; solid fill follows 40–60ms.
animations.whyPremium: Follow-through / secondary motion between outline and fill.
animations.dont: Don't delay >90ms.

animations.name: Variable-weight crossfade
animations.look: Light↔bold layers crossfade with micro Y settle.
animations.whyPremium: True weight morph via crossfade + micro motion.
animations.dont: Don't add bounce.

animations.name: Dim chorus / bright solo
animations.look: Phrase dim; solo word brightens with micro-lift.
animations.whyPremium: Hierarchy + micro Y — Ali-class polish.
animations.dont: Don't bounce teaching tone.

animations.name: Sliding pill highlight
animations.look: Pill interpolates between word bounds.
animations.whyPremium: Interpolated box motion > snap color — Captions-app premium feel.
animations.dont: Don't cover eyes — y≈0.58–0.68.

animations.name: Vertical stack pop
animations.look: Words stack; each springs with delay.
animations.whyPremium: Staggered springs + stack layout — mCaptions social territory.
animations.dont: Don't stack >3 lines on 9:16.

animations.name: Subtitle safe cinematic fade
animations.look: Smaller subtitle band, soft fade, no bounce.
animations.whyPremium: Restraint + safe-zone discipline — documentary/cinema.
animations.dont: Don't use impact fonts here.

animations.name: Mask reveal + light sweep
animations.look: Title revealed by mask; specular bar sweeps glyphs.
animations.whyPremium: Composable mask + secondary glint + motion blur on sweep.
animations.dont: Don't leave glint looping.

animations.name: Parallax stacked type
animations.look: FG word moves more than BG line; fake depth.
animations.whyPremium: Multi-layer parallax + blur-by-depth + shadow separation.
animations.dont: Don't parallax body captions.

animations.name: 3D camera orbit title
animations.look: Text in 3D; camera orbits then settles readable.
animations.whyPremium: True 3D camera + settle + motion blur.
animations.dont: Don't keep orbiting during VO.

animations.name: Cascade stagger + blur falloff
animations.look: Per-letter cascade with blur/opacity falloff.
animations.whyPremium: Feathered range selectors + multi-prop + graph easing.
animations.dont: Don't letter-stagger body ASR.

animations.name: Tracking expand (letter-spacing)
animations.look: Collapsed tracking expands to final spacing.
animations.whyPremium: Typographic tracking animation + settle — editorial luxury.
animations.dont: Don't expand past safe sides.

animations.name: Focus-pull title
animations.look: Heavy defocus → sharp as racking focus.
animations.whyPremium: Photographic language (focus) + opacity.
animations.dont: Don't use on tiny captions.

animations.name: Chromatic aberration impact
animations.look: Brief RGB split on hit, then clean.
animations.whyPremium: Controlled FX pulse (not full-time glitch) + settle.
animations.dont: Don't leave CA on for readability.

animations.name: Velocity echo trails
animations.look: Ghost copies offset in time during fast move.
animations.whyPremium: Echo/secondary forms during velocity.
animations.dont: Don't keep echoes after settle.

animations.name: Liquid morph word-swap
animations.look: Word A melts into Word B in same slot.
animations.whyPremium: Distortion/liquid used sparingly for emphasis.
animations.dont: Don't morph mid-phoneme.

animations.name: Anticipation squash title
animations.look: Tiny squash opposite, then expand slam + settle.
animations.whyPremium: Anticipation + squash/stretch + overshoot principle stack.
animations.dont: Don't squash multi-line body captions.

animations.name: Occlusion text-behind (polished)
animations.look: Clean cutout over type; edge refine + contact shadow.
animations.whyPremium: Depth illusion + contact shadow + refined matte.
animations.exampleBeat: Text mid-ground; subject crosses with contact shadow
animations.dont: Don't skip edge refine on hair.

animations.name: Ink brush write-on
animations.look: Brush/ink stroke reveals title along path.
animations.whyPremium: Stroke-on-path + texture — above typewriter.
animations.dont: Don't use for full VO track.

animations.name: Neon flicker sign
animations.look: Neon tubes flicker on with glow layers then hold.
animations.whyPremium: Multi-pass glow + limited flicker + settle.
animations.dont: Don't flicker through paragraphs.

animations.name: Line-grow + type fade
animations.look: Rule draws; type fades/slides above.
animations.whyPremium: Two-stage reveal: structure then type — editorial.
animations.dont: Don't start type before rule ≥50%.

animations.name: Impact stamp (layered)
animations.look: Stamp + shadow slam + brief shake + flash frame.
animations.whyPremium: Designed density combo: stamp+shake+flash.
animations.dont: Don't use every line.

animations.name: Spring number roll
animations.look: Digits roll with per-digit stagger and spring.
animations.whyPremium: Per-digit stagger + spring — above linear counters.
animations.dont: Don't finish before number spoken.

animations.name: Match-move title stick
animations.look: Title sticks to tracked point on moving cam/object.
animations.whyPremium: 3D camera solve / point track — type in world space.
animations.exampleBeat: Stick to lens ring; fade when track confident
animations.dont: Don't show during track slip.

animations.name: Shape-layer burst
animations.look: Geometric shards burst from impact then fade.
animations.whyPremium: Shape particles with stagger + overshoot — Envato staple.
animations.dont: Don't obscure faces.

animations.name: Tracked lower third (planar)
animations.look: Nameplate follows planar track on wall/laptop/plane.
animations.whyPremium: Footage interaction via tracking — agency premium.
animations.dont: Don't start before track stable.

animations.name: Callout draw + glow settle
animations.look: Stroke draws around detail; soft glow settles.
animations.whyPremium: Path draw + secondary glow — two-stage motion.
animations.dont: Don't share band with captions.

animations.name: Ken Burns eased path
animations.look: Still zooms/pans on curved ease toward eye/product.
animations.whyPremium: Ease-in-out path + single dominant axis.
animations.dont: Don't animate X+Y aggressively together.

animations.name: Card flip 3D
animations.look: Info card flips on Y revealing reverse.
animations.whyPremium: Perspective 3D + shadow + settle.
animations.dont: Don't flip while fine text must be read mid-turn.

animations.name: Optical-flow speed ramp
animations.look: Ramp 0.5×→2× with optical flow; freeze on impact.
animations.whyPremium: Optical flow + intentional freeze — retention craft.
animations.dont: Don't ramp dialogue talking-head.

animations.name: Zoom punch + radial blur
animations.look: Punch-in with brief radial blur that clears on settle.
animations.whyPremium: Velocity blur as secondary to scale.
animations.dont: Don't leave radial on settled frame.

animations.name: Map route + pulse dot
animations.look: Path draws; tip pulse; pin pops.
animations.whyPremium: Staggered pin pops + pulse — travel editorial.
animations.dont: Don't show tiny street labels.

animations.name: Screenshot spring dock
animations.look: UI card springs from below with shadow lift.
animations.whyPremium: Spring physics + shadow secondary + settle.
animations.dont: Don't cover captions with UI.

animations.name: Cursor / hand UI guide
animations.look: Cursor/hand taps UI or product hotspot.
animations.whyPremium: Guided attention with easing + click scale.
animations.dont: Don't cover the detail indicated.

animations.name: Chapter progress rail
animations.look: Thin mid-frame rail with chapter ticks filling.
animations.whyPremium: Editorial progress UI clear of bottom safe zone.
animations.exampleBeat: Rail at y≈0.53 fills with tip
animations.dont: Don't put rail in bottom 35%.

animations.name: Organic light leak overlay
animations.look: Warm analog leak drifts across cut with soft-light.
animations.whyPremium: Texture/overlay grade language — cinematic.
animations.dont: Don't stack leak+flash+glitch.

animations.name: Film grain + vignette
animations.look: Subtle animated grain + soft vignette unify plate.
animations.whyPremium: Texture cohesion — cinematic title packs.
animations.dont: Don't crush fine type with grain.

animations.name: Cinematic camera HUD
animations.look: REC, timecode, exposure, AF box — mono, blinking REC.
animations.whyPremium: Themed UI overlay with timing discipline + safe insets.
animations.dont: Don't cover faces whole tip.

animations.name: Specular glint bar
animations.look: Thin diagonal highlight sweeps once across logo/title.
animations.whyPremium: Secondary light motion — luxury/editorial cue.
animations.dont: Don't loop glint every second.

animations.name: Outer glow breathe
animations.look: Soft glow amplitude breathes then rests.
animations.whyPremium: Controlled secondary motion after primary land.
animations.dont: Don't breathe forever under dense captions.

animations.name: Floor reflection type
animations.look: Mirrored fade of title beneath glossy floor.
animations.whyPremium: Fake reflection = depth cue in luxury titles.
animations.dont: Don't use over busy floors.

animations.name: Audio-reactive scale
animations.look: Scale/brightness pulses with music amplitude.
animations.whyPremium: Audio-driven motion — beat sync beyond manual markers.
animations.dont: Don't react every sample — smooth + threshold.

animations.name: Drop-shadow depth lift
animations.look: As type scales in, shadow softens/offsets to fake lift.
animations.whyPremium: Shadow as secondary motion tied to Z-fake.
animations.dont: Don't use hard 0-blur shadows on cinematic grades.

animations.name: Dual-exposure type blend
animations.look: Type blended into footage via screen/add or silhouette.
animations.whyPremium: Compositing interaction — type lives in the image.
animations.dont: Don't use low-contrast plates.

animations.name: Whip-blur match cut
animations.look: Directional blur hides cut; vectors match exit→enter.
animations.whyPremium: Matched motion vectors + blur + whoosh.
animations.dont: Don't whip without matching pan.

animations.name: Optical iris wipe
animations.look: Aperture-like circle wipe centered on lens/subject.
animations.whyPremium: On-niche metaphor + feathered matte + timed SFX.
animations.dont: Don't use 1s+ iris on hooks.

animations.name: Grade flash (2-frame)
animations.look: 2-frame near-white/warm flash timed to hit SFX.
animations.whyPremium: Short, intentional, graded — not 15-frame default.
animations.dont: Don't use long default flashes.

animations.name: Graded glitch transition
animations.look: Short RGB/block glitch ~40% intensity with grade intact.
animations.whyPremium: Intensity discipline + SFX sync.
animations.dont: Don't stack with shake+flash.

animations.name: Zoom-through letter portal
animations.look: Camera pushes through giant glyph into next scene.
animations.whyPremium: Match-cut portal with opacity falloff.
animations.exampleBeat: Push through O into location B-roll
animations.dont: Don't use with small captions.

animations.name: Typographic reflow layout
animations.look: Words rearrange stacked→inline with springs.
animations.whyPremium: Layout animation, not just entrance — editorial kinetic.
animations.exampleBeat: Two stacked words spring onto one baseline
animations.dont: Don't reflow while still reading start.

animations.name: Cinematic vertical credit
animations.look: Slow vertical crawl with optical spacing; fade head/tail.
animations.whyPremium: Restraint, timing, opacity masking — film language.
animations.dont: Don't speed crawl unreadably.

animations.name: Beat-synced cascade sequence
animations.look: On each beat next word springs; previous dims.
animations.whyPremium: Musical sequencing + spring + dim hierarchy.
animations.dont: Don't fight ASR on dialogue tips.

animations.name: Split wipe + grade mismatch
animations.look: SOOC|Edited split; divider wipe; grade contrast.
animations.whyPremium: Wiped divider + labeled panes + intentional grade delta.
animations.dont: Don't put paragraphs in panes.

animations.name: Center lockup breathe
animations.look: Logo+wordmark scales almost imperceptibly after land.
animations.whyPremium: Post-land secondary motion — luxury restraint.
animations.dont: Don't breathe >3%.

animations.name: Typewriter + blinking cursor
animations.look: Characters appear with cursor blink and soft click SFX.
animations.whyPremium: Secondary cursor layer + timing discipline — not raw typewriter.
animations.dont: Don't type faster than readable aloud.

animations.name: Word magnet snap
animations.look: Words fly from offscreen and magnet-snap into line.
animations.whyPremium: Staggered trajectories + overshoot settle.
animations.exampleBeat: Words magnet from L with 80ms stagger
animations.dont: Don't magnet every ASR word for long tips.

animations.name: Scale-blur impact word
animations.look: One word scales 1.6→1 with heavy blur clearing.
animations.whyPremium: Multi-prop impact (scale+blur+opacity) — punch vocabulary.
animations.dont: Don't impact every word.

animations.name: Gradient wipe title
animations.look: Soft gradient matte reveals title left→right.
animations.whyPremium: Feathered matte > hard wipe — premium soft reveal.
animations.dont: Don't use hard rectangular wipe for luxury.

animations.name: RGB duplicate offset settle
animations.look: R/G/B copies offset then converge to clean type.
animations.whyPremium: Chromatic settle as entrance — controlled CA.
animations.dont: Don't leave RGB copies visible after settle.

animations.name: Paper tear wipe
animations.look: Torn-edge matte reveals next shot.
animations.whyPremium: Textured matte + organic edge — editorial/print feel.
animations.dont: Don't use on every cut.

animations.name: Circle mask pop
animations.look: Circular mask expands from product hotspot.
animations.whyPremium: Mask-as-motion + overshoot — CapCut/AE staple elevated.
animations.dont: Don't expand covering face mid-VO.

animations.name: Parallax BG drift plate
animations.look: Slow drifting textured BG behind type for depth.
animations.whyPremium: Continuous subtle secondary motion under titles.
animations.dont: Don't drift so fast it distracts from type.

animations.name: Caption soft exit settle
animations.look: Caption exits with scale-down + blur + opacity (not hard cut).
animations.whyPremium: Exits matter — premium packs animate out with settle.
animations.dont: Don't hard-cut captions between phrases.

animations.name: Em-dash split title

animations.dont: Don't squeeze past side safe margins.
